The '''Progenitor's Call''' was a [[The Force/Legends|Force]] technique used by the adepts of the [[Order of Shasa]]. The adept using this power enjoyed a better protection from attacks in combat. This could be achieved by making use of the natural power of<ref name="DoH3">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20040219manaan3|series=Manaan: Depths of History|text=Part 3: The Order of Shasa}}</ref> the giant [[Firaxan shark/Legends|Firaxan shark]] that the [[Selkath/Legends|Selkath]] called the [[Progenitor]].<ref name="cok1">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/KOTORCreaturesFiraxa|text=Creatures of KOTOR 1: Firaxa and Gizka}}</ref>
